# Change or incident, YYYY-MM-DD

Host or service:

## Context

What prompted the work? Link the research, decision, or guide.

## Actions and outcome

What changed? What did you observe? Keep secrets and raw private output outside Git.

## Verification and recovery

Which checks ran and what were their results? What is the rollback or recovery procedure? Record anything still unverified.

## Learning and follow-up

What would you do differently? Update the owning concept, guide, inventory, or service record and link it here.
